meta_description:
140K likes, 1,003 comments - farahdhukai on November 21, 2020: "💖How I remove my makeup and take care of my skin and lashes at the same time!
.
🙌🏽You will need:
 -reusable microfibre pads from amazon. I got a 16 pack of bamboo pads for $12
-hemp oil from the grocery store. I got this whole bottle for $12 and use it for removing makeup, in my hair, on my skin, body, everywhere
.
Wet your pad in lukewarm water
Dab hemp oil
Massage onto skin
Remove in upward motion - no lashes lost!
Cleanse with your fav cleanser
-
#farahdhukai #diy #diyskincare #instagramreels".
